The article develops higher-order-influence-function U-statistic estimators for nonlinear functionals under low nuisance regularity and discusses optimal non-root-n rates.
The paper studies ATE minimax lower bounds and a clean hybrid smoothness/structure-agnostic estimator with doubly robust asymptotic linearity.
The paper proposes density-power IPW/DR ATE estimators for outliers and states that naive robust DR needs bias correction to preserve double robustness.
The empirical-HOIF construction avoids a smoothness requirement on the covariate density and extends to confounding-controlled average treatment effects under clean sampling.
robustate implements debiased trimmed IPW ATE inference for limited overlap and illustrates it with right-heart-catheterization data.
